title: Grilled Chicken Ravioli Alfredo
description: Cheese ravioli served in a rich garlic Parmesan cream sauce with grilled chicken, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, and Parmesan.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the ravioli according to the package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.
In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and sauté until lightly browned.
Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and milk, then simmer gently for 3–4 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese and optional cream cheese until the sauce is smooth and velvety.
Season with Italian seasoning, black pepper, salt, and red chili flakes if using.
Add the cooked ravioli and gently toss to coat. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if the sauce becomes too thick.
Plate the ravioli with plenty of sauce.
Top with sliced grilled chicken, sautéed mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, parsley, and optional green olives.
Finish with freshly grated Parmesan, cracked black pepper, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
notes: Do not overcook the ravioli—they become delicate once coated in the sauce.
Freshly grated Parmesan melts much better than pre-shredded cheese.
A small amount of cream cheese makes the sauce extra silky and stable.
For an even richer flavor, substitute half of the butter with garlic herb butter.
Serve with warm garlic bread and a simple Caesar salad.
